name: worktrees

steps.stdout:
usage: ws-git worktree add <dir> (<session>[@<commit>] | <tag>)
       ws-git worktree list
       ws-git worktree remove <dir>

M a.txt
worktrees:
worktree rev: reviewer@<c3> (read-only)
